mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gene_defect (universe_id, defect_name, frequency, severity, solution, source_tag, trace_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{universeId}, #{defectName}, #{frequency}, #{severity}, #{solution}, #{sourceTag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{traceId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, universe_id, defect_name, frequency, severity, solution, source_tag, trace_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM gene_defect WHERE universe_id = #{universeId}
